title: Multiple Insulin Profiles
symptom: The user requests incorporation of multiple insulin profiles in xDrip+ to allow for basal and bolus differential in both MDI and pump, extended boluses, FIASP, and other insulin situations. They state that this is an area where xDrip+ is severely lacking.
evidence_quote: I know this has been brought up before, but could you incorporate multiple insulin profiles in xDrip+?
